journey.name: DD-02 The editor can set, change and clear a due date
journey.description:
Covers FR-13's write half. The due-date row has three states and the controls change with them: with no date it reads "No due date" and offers "Set date"; with a date it offers "Change date" and additionally "Clear date" (TaskEditorScreen.kt:200-232).
"Book dentist" starts with no due date, which makes it the row that exercises all three.
Preconditions: adb shell am force-stop com.rounds.test.to_dolist adb shell am start -n com.rounds.test.to_dolist/.MainActivity --es qa_failure_rate 0.0

actions.action: Verify that "No due date" is on screen
Verify that "Set date" is on screen and "Clear date" is not
Verify that a date picker dialog is on screen with "OK" and "Cancel" buttons
Select a date in the picker and tap "OK"
Verify that "No due date" is no longer on screen
Verify that "Change date" is now on screen instead of "Set date"
Verify that "Clear date" is now on screen
Verify that "No due date" is on screen again
Verify that "Set date" is on screen and "Clear date" is not
